2610.13660.title: Pretraining and Test-Time Training Budgets Matter for ARC: A Controlled Study of VARC and TRM
2610.13660.paper_summary: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus (ARC) is increasingly used to evaluate whether neural networks can infer task-specific transformations from few demonstrations. Recent ARC models differ in architecture, but also in broader training and evaluation protocols, including pretraining data, data augmentation, test-time setup, and optimization budgets, making conclusions about architecture benefits debatable. In this work, we study how the performance of the vision-inspired VARC and recursion-based TRM models is affected by pretraining and test-time training (TTT) budgets under a common inductive protocol on ARC-AGI-1. We cross five pretraining budgets with four TTT budgets for each test task. Each budget specifies a task-variant count and total sample presentations, defining the controlled training budgets. We observe that increasing TTT sample presentations improves the standard ARC pass@2 metric in all settings for both models. Increasing the TTT task-variant count consistently helps only TRM, whereas VARC often performs better with fewer variants. VARC also remains competitive without pretraining, while TRM benefits much more from it. These results show that pretraining and TTT budgets affect ARC evaluation and motivate reporting at comparable budgets.
2610.13660.paper_summary_zh: 抽象與推理語料庫（ARC）越來越多地用於評估神經網絡是否能從少量示範中推斷特定任務的轉換。最近的ARC模型在架構上有所不同，但在更廣泛的訓練和評估協議上也有所不同，包括預訓練數據、數據增強、測試時設置和優化預算，使得對架構優勢的結論變得有爭議。在這項工作中，我們研究了視覺啟發的VARC模型和基於遞歸的TRM模型在ARC-AGI-1上，預訓練和測試時訓練（TTT）預算如何影響其性能，並在一個共同的歸納協議下進行。對於每個測試任務，我們將五個預訓練預算與四個TTT預算進行交叉。每個預算指定了一個任務變體計數和總樣本展示，定義了受控的訓練預算。我們觀察到，增加TTT樣本展示在所有設置中都能改善兩個模型的標準ARC pass@2指標。增加TTT任務變體計數持續幫助只有TRM，而VARC通常在變體較少的情況下表現更好。VARC在沒有預訓練的情況下仍然具有競爭力，而TRM則從中獲益更多。這些結果表明，預訓練和TTT預算影響ARC評估，並促使在可比較的預算下報告。
